description: core/management introspection vectors for protocol version 1 (spec/management.cddl): path:trace and topology.get. The top-level vectors are the manage-request and manage-response frames the cases use and gossip frames each holding one peer-advert, round-tripped like any other file. The `introspection` section gives, for each frame, the shape a typed decoder must read it as and every field; frames each breaking one rule of a shape, which a typed decoder must refuse; the answer built for a path.trace; traces run against a scripted peer and clock; the topology read from an advert's `topology/peers` extension; the graph assembled from a directory; and topology.get run against a scripted peer. Every outcome is written by hand from the spec, never produced by an implementation. Device-ids, keys and signatures are structural bytes and the adverts are not verified.
